medium: What is the average trip duration in minutes, broken down by rider type (member vs casual)? How do the two groups compare?
hard: Rank the top 10 start stations by total trip count. For each, what share of trips were taken by members vs casual riders? Are some stations much more member-dominated than others?
Compute the average trip duration by hour of day. What are the peak hours, and how does the member-vs-casual pattern differ between morning rush (7-9am) and evening rush (5-7pm)?
very_complex: Find the 20 most popular station-to-station routes (start_station_id, end_station_id pairs). For each, compute the average trip duration. Are round trips (same start and end) over-represented in the top 20?

Compute the day-of-week and hour-of-day heatmap of trips for members vs casual riders. Identify the single (weekday, hour) cell with the biggest difference in member-vs-casual share — i.e. the slot that is most distinctly one rider type.
